elements.content: Grammar focus: Inversion After Negative & Limiting Adverbials.

Core Rule: When negative or limiting adverbials (e.g. Not only, Seldom, Hardly, Barely, Little, Under no circumstances ) are fronted for emphasis, the auxiliary verb precedes the subject: Adverbial + Auxiliary + Subject + Main Verb .

Not only did she win, she also set a record.
Seldom have I heard such nonsense.
Under no circumstances should you open it.
Only then did I understand.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence correctly applies negative inversion?
options: Not only does the framework streamline operations, but it reduces cost.
Not only the framework streamlines operations, but it reduces cost.
